Verses.10: And so the Angel said to them, "Do not be afraid. Behold, I bring you good news, that will bring great joy to all people.
Verses.11: For today, in the city of David, a savior was born for all. He is Christ the Lord.
Verses.12: And this will be a sign for you: you will find a baby wrapped in cloth, and lying in a manger."
Verses.13: Then suddenly a multitude of heavenly angels appeared with the angel, praising God, and saying,
Verses.14: "Glory to God in the highest! And peace on earth! God's desire for all peoples!"
Verses.22: After the days were completed for their purification according to the Law of Moses, they brought Him up to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord.
Verses.23: As it is written in the Law of the Lord, "Every firstborn male is to be consecrated to the Lord."
Verses.24: There they would offer a sacrifice in keeping with what has been stated in the Law of the Lord: "a pair of doves or two young pigeons."
Verses.25: And there was a man in Jerusalem called Simeon. He was righteous and devout, and was looking forward to the consolation of Israel. The Holy Spirit was upon him.
Verses.26: It has been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
Verses.27: Moved by the Spirit, he went into the temple. The parents brought the child Jesus brought in to carry out the custom of the Law.
Verses.28: Then Simeon took the Child into his arms and blessed God. He said,
Verses.29:
"Lord, now let Your servant go in peace.
	You have kept Your promise.
Verses.30: For my eyes have seen Your salvation,
Verses.31: which You prepared in the sight of all people.
Verses.32:
A light of revelation for the nations,
	and the glory of Your people Israel."
Verses.33: The Child's father and mother marveled at what was said about Him.
Verses.34: Then Simeon blessed them and said to His mother Mary, "Behold, this Child is destined to cause the fall and rise of many in Israel. He is a sign that will be opposed,
Verses.35: for in the end through Him the thoughts of many will be revealed. This will even pierce your own soul with a sword."
